chapter: Swing, singers, Ed Fox and recordings
title: The term 'Western swing' and Chicago versus New York musicians
summary: New York snobbery; Apollo standby band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: The term has been used, supposedly by musicians in your days, picked up by writers, in describing the Hines' band as "Western swing." Did you ever hear that term?
Yeah. I heard that. I heard that.
When did you first hear that term?
I can't remember, but I remember hearing it.
It just started, it started in New York.
anything west of the Hudson is -- can't be very good, that attitude.
